dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Relax, bro, relax. It's just a scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: This isn't a real battle. Just a drill, yeah? Your buddy is a-okay. Totally safe.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You can jump right back in once you've recovered. Just kick back and chill for now, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I'll get your buddy to swing by in a sec. Don't go too hard, or your wound won't heal right.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: That's right, you're doing just fine, kiddo. Go catch a few Z's.
